description: Deterministic retrieval module — combined git-signal strategy producing CandidateSet from ProblemStatement + repo + temporal_bound

acceptance_criteria.description: New package src/commit_investigator/retrieval/ with __init__.py, strategies.py, retriever.py. __init__.py exports: retrieve_candidates, RetrievalConfig, RecallDiagnostic, compute_recall_at_k.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Import test: from commit_investigator.retrieval import retrieve_candidates, RetrievalConfig, RecallDiagnostic, compute_recall_at_k

acceptance_criteria.description: RetrievalConfig dataclass with fields: max_candidates (int, default=100), strategies (list[str], default=['file_log','keyword_grep','pickaxe','blame']), fallback_recency_threshold (int, default=10), file_log_per_file (int, default=50), keyword_grep_per_kw (int, default=30), pickaxe_per_symbol (int, default=50), blame_per_file (int, default=100). Invalid strategy names ignored or rejected at retrieve time (test asserts unknown names do not invoke git).
acceptance_criteria.verification: Unit test: default construction has expected values; override max_candidates=50 works; config.strategies=['blame'] results in only blame git calls

acceptance_criteria.description: retrieve_candidates(problem: ProblemStatement, git: GitContextProvider, config: RetrievalConfig | None = None) → CandidateSet. Runs enabled strategies from config.strategies in combined mode. Returns CandidateSet with commits ranked by signal_count desc, best_rank asc. Temporal bound comes from git.temporal_bound (not a separate parameter).
acceptance_criteria.verification: Integration test with unittest.mock MagicMock GitContextProvider (or project-root git fixture): controlled per-strategy returns produce deterministic rank order matching AC8 rules

acceptance_criteria.description: File-log strategy: for each unique extracted_file in ProblemStatement, resolve via git.resolve_file_path(), then for each returned path call git.search_commits_by_file(path, max_results=config.file_log_per_file). Skip files with empty resolve_file_path(). Deduplicate commits by commit_id across files and paths.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Unit test: mock resolve_file_path returning 2 paths for one file; assert search_commits_by_file called twice with max_results=file_log_per_file; merged commits deduped by SHA

acceptance_criteria.description: Keyword-grep strategy: for each unique extracted_keyword (case-sensitive match, deduped preserving first occurrence), git.search_commits_by_keyword(keyword, max_results=config.keyword_grep_per_kw). Deduplicates by commit_id across keywords.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Unit test: mock with duplicate keywords in ProblemStatement; assert search_commits_by_keyword called once per unique keyword with max_results=keyword_grep_per_kw

acceptance_criteria.description: Pickaxe strategy: for each unique extracted_symbol (deduped preserving first occurrence), git.search_commits_by_pickaxe(symbol, max_results=config.pickaxe_per_symbol). Deduplicates by commit_id across symbols.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Unit test: mock GitContextProvider with known symbols; pickaxe returns expected commits; duplicate symbols invoke pickaxe once

acceptance_criteria.description: Blame strategy: for each resolved file path (same resolve_file_path loop as file_log), git.get_blame(path, line_start=1, line_end=config.blame_per_file), parse blame output, extract unique commit SHAs. Skip boundary commits prefixed with '^'. Abbreviated SHAs normalized to full 40-char hex via a public GitContextProvider API (add resolve_ref(ref)->str|None wrapper if needed; retrieval/ must not call private _resolve_ref).
acceptance_criteria.verification: Unit test: mock blame output with abbreviated SHAs and ^prefixed SHAs; assert output commit_ids are 40-char hex, no ^ commits; grep retrieval/ for _resolve_ref returns zero matches

acceptance_criteria.description: Signal-count ranking: each commit scored by number of distinct enabled strategies that found it (1-4). best_rank = minimum 1-based position within that strategy's ordered result list before merge. Ties broken by best_rank ascending. Final ordering: signal_count desc, best_rank asc, commit_id asc (stable final tie-break).
acceptance_criteria.verification: Unit test: commit found by 3 strategies ranks above commit found by 1; equal signal_count broken by lower best_rank; equal best_rank broken by commit_id lexicographic order

acceptance_criteria.description: Recency fallback: when unique signal-driven commit count (post cross-strategy dedup, pre max_candidates trim) is strictly less than config.fallback_recency_threshold, augment with git.list_recent_commits(max_results=config.max_candidates). Fallback commits have retrieval_signal='recency_fallback', are deduped against existing signal commits, and fill only until max_candidates total.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Unit test: zero-signal ProblemStatement triggers fallback_triggered=True; mock list_recent_commits returns SHAs overlapping signal set — overlap excluded from final commits

acceptance_criteria.description: CandidateSet.retrieval_metadata dict with keys: strategies_used (list[str] — enabled strategies from config actually executed), total_raw_candidates (int — unique commits after merge/dedup, before max_candidates trim), signal_counts (dict[int,int] mapping signal_count→num_commits on pre-trim set), fallback_triggered (bool), temporal_bound (str — git.temporal_bound or '' if None).
acceptance_criteria.verification: Unit test: metadata present with all required keys and correct types; total_raw_candidates equals len(pre-trim unique set); signal_counts sum equals total_raw_candidates

acceptance_criteria.description: Each CandidateCommit in the result has: commit_id (full 40-char SHA), rank (1-based contiguous after trim), retrieval_signal (comma-separated enabled strategy names that found it, sorted alphabetically; 'recency_fallback' for fallback-only commits), summary (commit message first line from FileHistoryEntry.message or get_commit_message first line), files_changed (list from git.get_touched_files(commit_id) or [] when None), date (author date from FileHistoryEntry.date when available).
acceptance_criteria.verification: Unit test: CandidateCommit fields populated; retrieval_signal='blame,file_log' when both found commit; get_touched_files invoked for output commits

acceptance_criteria.description: Output capped at config.max_candidates commits. When more raw candidates exist, lowest-ranked commits (by AC8 ordering) are trimmed; ranks renumbered 1..N contiguously.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Unit test: set max_candidates=5 with 8 raw unique commits; result has exactly 5 commits with ranks 1-5; trimmed commits are the 3 lowest by AC8 order

acceptance_criteria.description: RecallDiagnostic dataclass with fields: ground_truth_sha (str), found (bool), rank (int | None), total_candidates (int), strategies_that_found (list[str]). compute_recall_at_k(candidate_set, ground_truth_sha, k=100) → RecallDiagnostic; rank is 1-based position in candidate_set.commits or None when not found within k.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Unit test: ground truth at rank 3 with k=100 → found=True rank=3 strategies_that_found non-empty; ground truth absent → found=False rank=None; ground truth at rank 150 with k=100 → found=False

acceptance_criteria.description: Package isolation: retrieval/ imports only from commit_investigator.extraction (ProblemStatement), commit_investigator.models (CandidateSet, CandidateCommit), commit_investigator.infra (GitContextProvider, FileHistoryEntry). Zero imports from agent/, eval/, governance/.
Each module file under src/commit_investigator/retrieval/ ≤ 300 lines.
acceptance_criteria.verification: wc -l on all .py files in retrieval package

acceptance_criteria.description: tests/test_retrieval.py with ≥20 tests covering all ACs and edge cases. pytest tests/ passes with zero regressions (232+ existing tests).
acceptance_criteria.verification: pytest tests/ --ignore=tests/_v2_archive exits 0; test_retrieval.py exists with ≥20 tests

edge_cases.description: ProblemStatement with empty extracted_files, extracted_symbols, extracted_keywords → recency fallback triggers, returns non-empty CandidateSet (when repo has commits)
edge_cases.verification: Unit test: empty signals → fallback_triggered=True in metadata; len(commits)>0 when list_recent_commits returns entries

edge_cases.description: ProblemStatement with files that don't resolve to any repo path → those files skipped, other strategies still run
edge_cases.verification: Unit test: resolve_file_path returns [] for one file + valid keyword → keyword results returned; file_log/blame not called for unresolvable file

edge_cases.description: All enabled strategies return the same commit → appears once at rank 1 with signal_count equal to len(enabled strategies)
edge_cases.verification: Unit test: mock all four strategies returning same SHA; result has 1 commit at rank 1 with signal_count=4 and retrieval_signal listing all four strategies alphabetically

edge_cases.description: Blame output contains boundary commits (^sha) → skipped (initial commits before the blame range)
edge_cases.verification: Unit test: blame output with ^-prefixed SHAs; those SHAs not in result

edge_cases.description: GitContextProvider methods returning None/empty on failure (GitContextProvider failure mode) → that strategy contributes zero commits; other strategies still succeed
edge_cases.verification: Unit test: mock search_commits_by_keyword returning [] while pickaxe returns commits → result contains pickaxe commits only

edge_cases.description: Duplicate keywords/symbols in ProblemStatement don't cause duplicate strategy invocations or inflated signal counts
edge_cases.verification: Unit test: duplicate keywords → search_commits_by_keyword call_count equals unique keyword count; signal_count not inflated

edge_cases.description: max_candidates=0 returns empty CandidateSet with metadata (total_raw_candidates may be >0)
edge_cases.verification: Unit test: config max_candidates=0 → commits=[], metadata keys still present including total_raw_candidates

edge_cases.description: CandidateSet.temporal_bound populated from GitContextProvider.temporal_bound (empty string when provider temporal_bound is None)
edge_cases.verification: Unit test: provider with temporal_bound='abc123~1' → CandidateSet.temporal_bound='abc123~1'; unbounded provider → temporal_bound=''

out_of_scope: Time-window filtering (no empirical benefit per retrieval-spike ADR)
End-to-end integration with input pipeline (v4-input-pipeline P5)
Live eval against n=20 cases (v4-checkpoint-retrieval P6)
Per-strategy rank exposure beyond best_rank tie-breaker (CandidateCommit.retrieval_signal remains strategy names only; no model schema change)
verification_method: pytest tests/test_retrieval.py tests/ + grep import isolation + grep retrieval/ for _resolve_ref + wc -l file sizing + ReadLints on src/commit_investigator/retrieval/
